prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    sep=None
    for v in range(10):
        rs=sum(1 for r in range(h) if all(x==v for x in grid[r]))
        cs=sum(1 for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==v for r in range(h)))
        if rs>=1 and cs>=1:
            sep=v; break
    mark=[v for v in cnt if v!=sep and cnt[v]<cnt[[k for k in cnt if k!=sep][0]]]
    # background = most common color that is not separator
    bgv=[k for k in cnt if k!=sep]
    bg=max(bgv,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    rest=[k for k in bgv if k!=bg]
    mark=min(rest,key=lambda k:cnt[k]) if rest else None
    rsep=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in grid[r])]
    csep=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    def ranges(n,seps):
        rs=[];start=0
        for s in seps+[n]:
            if s>start: rs.append((start,s))
            start=s+1
        return rs

        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
